rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and appropriate discussion of ICM/TE/zona, but it overreaches from a single still image with speculative details such as partial collapse, absence of fragmentation/debris, and possible stage 4 vs 3 without clear visual certainty.

Thoroughly integrates age-related aneuploidy risk, prior live birth/miscarriage/ectopic history, PCOS, ovarian reserve markers, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, and transfer timing with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and well structured, with prognosis appropriately tied to morphology and maternal age; minor issue is some imprecision between implantation, clinical pregnancy, and live birth ranges.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: single embryo transfer, luteal support, early ectopic surveillance, cavity review, and discussion of PGT-A. Minor deviations include somewhat broad ancillary testing suggestions and lifestyle advice not tightly guideline-based.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, early beta-hCG/ultrasound monitoring, cavity assessment, miscarriage workup triggers, and future PGT-A discussion.
